composition_validation.configuration: Target-first immutable FusableConfig.merge; role-only profiles, explicit conflict resolution, scoped policy, tree-resolved live parents and preserved native preambles.
regressions: Multiple sources and diamond deduplication preserve target identity and immutable sources.
Structural and policy conflicts require explicit replacement or local override; invalid composition cannot replace an installed plan.
Profile/layer policy reaches actual GPTQ/AWQ parent execution, with extracted/printed provenance.
Renamed parents and weight paths resolve exclusively from the module plan; side-effecting preambles run once on success and fallback.

review_validation.scope: Import/guard cleanup and typed variable-length native operand collections; no synthetic zero-point operands.
regressions: Zero-free native contracts exclude zero-point operands.
Dynamic metadata arguments reject native forward rewriting.
